title: Sourcemeta One Playground Schema Trace RPC Input
description: Trace step-by-step evaluation of a JSON instance against a schema supplied in the request rather than one in the catalog, exposing each step, rule application, and decision point

stringifiedSchema.description: The JSON Schema to evaluate against, encoded as a string of valid JSON. It must be an object declaring its dialect with `$schema`. A `$ref` to a schema in this catalog resolves on the same terms as fetching that schema directly, and a `$ref` to anywhere else is refused
stringifiedSchema.$comment: Accepting the schema as a JSON-encoded string is a workaround for MCP clients that stringify non-string tool arguments before sending them. See https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/24599 and https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/python-sdk/issues/1112

stringifiedInstance.description: The JSON value to trace evaluation against, encoded as a string of valid JSON. The server parses this string before tracing, so non-string MCP clients can still send objects, numbers, booleans, null, or arrays without losing the JSON type. The reported `instancePositions` are line/column offsets within the parsed JSON content, not within the surrounding JSON-RPC envelope
stringifiedInstance.$comment: Accepting the instance as a JSON-encoded string is a workaround for MCP clients that stringify non-string tool arguments before sending them. See https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/24599 and https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/python-sdk/issues/1112
